source_caption_text:
We all know Future got a serious bag for this 😭💀

Cher and Future teamed up for Gap’s 2017 “Meet Me in the Gap” campaign, bringing two completely different musical worlds together for one unexpected commercial. To make the pairing work, they enlisted Atlanta producer Zaytoven to rework Sly and the Family Stone’s “Everyday People.”

Zaytoven flipped the classic into a trap-inspired version with bright piano melodies, heavy 808s and crisp hi-hats. Cher handles the big vocals while Future adds his signature Auto-Tuned ad-libs, making for a pretty wild combination.

The commercial was directed by Director X and featured Cher and Future performing together on a white staircase. What started as a Gap campaign eventually became a viral internet moment years later, with people revisiting the bizarre but memorable pairing.
